contentSummary: Health is an important aspect of learners ’ daily lives. At Grade 4 level, learners are ex pected to understand basic healthy practices such as hygi ene, nutrition, ex ercise, and cleanliness. Notation is the system used to read and write music using symbols. It helps learners understand how music is organised in terms of pitch, rhythm, and duration. At Grade 4, learners begin to recognise and perform basic musical notes, which are the foundation for singing, playing instruments and composing simple music. In line with the Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC), this topic develops learners’ abilities to perform, interpret, and appreciate music, while enhancing creativity, listening skills, and cultural awareness. Learners are encouraged to relate musical notation to songs and rhythms commonly found in Zambian communities.
